_comment: The single declaration of which model every agent CLI uses on every machine.
Nothing else may name a model: agent-config-apply writes these into
when a machine disagrees. Codex rewrites its own config whenever its model
picker is used, so apply runs on a timer and at Claude session start rather
JSON, not TOML, so it parses with the stdlib on any python3 (strix and the
Macs disagree on what `python3` resolves to, and tomllib needs 3.11+).

reviewed_models: codex models already considered. Anything Codex offers that is NOT listed here is reported by the doctor as a decision to make - that is the trigger for 'a cheaper/newer model shipped'.
claude.model matches claude/settings.json in this repo - change both together, or agent-config-apply and a fresh bootstrap will disagree.

claude.model is an ALIAS ('opus', 'opus[1m]') on purpose: Claude Code resolves an alias to the latest model in that line, so a new Opus is picked up with no edit. Codex has no alias - its model must be pinned, which is why the doctor reports unreviewed codex models.

claude_gpt is opt-in for claude --gpt. claude-router reads it per invocation; agent-config-apply keeps native Claude settings native. proxy_version is a deliberately reviewed release, not an automatic upgrade.
